name: Daily Page · test build (no model, test tables)

parameters.content:
## 1 Trigger
08:00 every day, or the Rebuild button. A rebuild within 10 minutes is refused (it costs model credit).

## 2 Fetch
Each source retries once. A failed source never stops the run.

## 3 Decide
Rules filter; the agent judges and calls tools per candidate.

## 4 Save and answer
One row per day: a rebuild replaces it, never adds a second one.

## 2 Fetch: my own accounts
Each branch runs only when its credential exists. They sit above the main line: n8n runs the upper branch first, so their results are ready when the sources are checked.

return $('Check sources and use cache').first().json.cacheUpdates.map((row) => ({ json: row }));
